newsitem.title: UK: Centrica shares up on SBC Warburg "buy".
newsitem.headline: Centrica shares up on SBC Warburg "buy".

text.p: Shares in Centrica Plc forged ahead on Tuesday as analysts at SBC Warburg issued a "buy" recommendation on the stock, dealers said.
The shares were up four pence at 62-3/4 by 1048 GMT on volume of 7.1 million.
Market sources said SBC Warburg had a 70p short-term price target and a 90p medium-term target for Centrica.
"The shares have been bombed out recently and they seem to be bouncing at last, helped by the strong market," one market-maker said.
Centrica, formerly the gas supply arm of Britsh Gas, was spun off in February. It sank from high of 77-1/2p in mid-February to a low of 56-1/2p on March 21.
